description_en: Retrieves the details of audio automated review results
description_zh: 调用本接口获取音频审核详情
name: GetMediaAuditAudioResultDetail

parameters.help_en: The audio ID. You can query the audio ID in the ApsaraVideo VOD console or obtain it from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 音频ID。可通过点播控制台查询音频ID或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口请求后会返回音频ID
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, all results are returned without pagination
parameters.help_zh: 分页号。可选填，不填则返回所有结果不分页
parameters.name: page_no
